name: zimage_texdir_find_or_append_by_path
description: zImage::TexDir_FindOrAppendByPath finds an existing texture-directory entry by basename or appends a pending entry for a new path.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zImage/zVideo texture-directory source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46d810 validates temporarily truncating the path at the last dot, searching the texture directory by basename, restoring the dot, and returning the existing entry when found.

Binary Ninja assembly validates appending at g_zImage_TexDirEntryCount, incrementing the count, deriving baseName with TexDirSetBaseNameFromPath, setting loadState to 2, and returning the new entry when no match exists.
The native smoke verifies existing-entry lookup, extension restoration, append count, basename extraction, and pending loadState behavior.
